This is a repository for the **internal** data preparation/standardization/harmonization development  for the **Open Soil Spectral Library**, as part of the [**Soil Spectroscopy for Global Good**](https://soilspectroscopy.org) initiative.

You can find more information about the prepared soil spectral libraries in the [**Listed Libraries** section](https://docs.soilspectroscopy.org/libraries.html) in the [**Manual**](https://docs.soilspectroscopy.org/), or interactively at the [**OSSL Chemometrics** tool](https://soilspectroscopy.github.io/ossl-chemometrics/).

Full documentation is available in the [**OSSL Manual**](https://docs.soilspectroscopy.org/).
